question: For the patients with the normal glutamic pylvic transaminase level, how many of them are male?
evidence: normal glutamic pylvic transaminase level refers to GOT < 60; male refers to Sex = 'M';
clarification: Count each distinct ID only once.
gold: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.GOT < 60 AND T1.SEX = 'M'
gold0: SELECT COUNT(T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.GOT < 60 AND T1.SEX = 'M'

b.request: How many distinct male patients (Sex = 'M') have at least one Laboratory record with GOT < 60, counting each distinct patient ID only once?
b.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) FROM Patient P INNER JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID WHERE P.SEX = 'M' AND L.GOT < 60

d.request: For patients with a normal glutamic pyruvic transaminase level (GOT < 60), how many are male (Sex = 'M'), counting each distinct patient ID only once?
d.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) FROM Patient P INNER JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID WHERE L.GOT < 60 AND P.SEX = 'M'
